integrity: The collision equation reduces exactly to p^2-3q^2=-2. An elementary descent by multiplication with 2-sqrt(3) proves that every positive solution lies on one Pell orbit. A three-step recurrence proves the mod-5 and mod-3 index obstruction. The packaged computation is corroborative and independently evaluates J_2 by factorization.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only collisions between a prime argument and an argument twice a prime. It does not classify arbitrary equal values of J_2 and does not assert infinitely many prime-coordinate Pell indices. An older 2003 Jordan-function source has only year-level publication evidence in the inspected material; the exact structured date uses the earliest verified calendar day, 14 September 2010.
title: A negative-Pell spine for prime--semiprime Jordan-totient collisions
